QUOTE: `llama_tokenize(vocab, text, len, nullptr, 0, ...)` passes no output buffer. llama.cpp answers with the negative of the required token count... It allocates `vector<int32_t>(n)` and calls `llama_tokenize` again with that buffer to fill it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the file and describes the two-call size-query-then-fill pattern in tokenize (lines 49-71) and the two-call buffer retry in detokenize.
